title: Review Findings
description: Shared schema for perspective reviewer subagents (security, maintainability, performance, quality). SARIF-inspired but simplified format for structured review findings.

perspective.description: Which review perspective this output represents.

verdict.description: Overall verdict: clean (no issues), findings (issues found but not blocking), blocked (cannot proceed).

summary.description: Brief summary of the review from this perspective.

findings.description: Individual findings from this perspective. Empty array when verdict is clean.

finding.description: Concise description of what was found.

recommendation.description: Actionable recommendation for addressing the finding.

ci_hint.description: How to catch this automatically in CI or pre-commit in the future.

teaching.description: Educational context explaining why this matters (2-3 sentences).

source.description: Origin of the finding: 'agent' or the reviewer's GitHub login.

effort.description: Estimated effort to address this finding.
